name: ho2_succ_add
stmt: theorem ho2_succ_add (n m : Nat) : Nat.succ n + m = Nat.succ (n + m) := by

name: ho3_le_succ_self
stmt: theorem ho3_le_succ_self (n : Nat) : n ≤ Nat.succ n := by

name: ho4_cons_append
stmt: theorem ho4_cons_append (x : Nat) (l1 l2 : List Nat) : (x :: l1) ++ l2 = x :: (l1 ++ l2) := by

name: ho5_add_one_eq_succ
stmt: theorem ho5_add_one_eq_succ (n : Nat) : n + 1 = Nat.succ n := by

name: ho6_three_mul
stmt: theorem ho6_three_mul (n : Nat) : 3 * n = n + n + n := by

name: ho7_succ_le_inv
stmt: theorem ho7_succ_le_inv (n m : Nat) (h : Nat.succ n ≤ Nat.succ m) : n ≤ m := by

name: ho8_len_cons
stmt: theorem ho8_len_cons (x : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (x :: l).length = l.length + 1 := by

name: ho9_double_swap
stmt: theorem ho9_double_swap (n m : Nat) : n + m + n = 2 * n + m := by

name: ho10_pos_add
stmt: theorem ho10_pos_add (n m : Nat) (h1 : 0 < n) (h2 : 0 < m) : 0 < n + m := by

name: ho11_mul_add_one
stmt: theorem ho11_mul_add_one (n m : Nat) : n * (m + 1) = n * m + n := by

name: ho12_append_len
stmt: theorem ho12_append_len (l1 l2 : List Nat) : (l1 ++ l2).length = l1.length + l2.length := by
